## Morphix 1.10.0 — Scan documents, send from your phone, make QR codes 📄📱

Every file tool you need — one shortcut away. PDF, images, Office, audio & video, OCR and offline speech-to-text.

### Download
- **Windows:** `Morphix_Windows_1.10.0.zip` — unzip it and run `Morphix.exe` (keep it together with the `_internal` folder).
- **macOS (Apple Silicon):** `Morphix_macOS_1.10.0.dmg` — open it and drag Morphix into Applications. The first time, right-click Morphix → **Open**.
- **Linux (x86_64):** `Morphix-1.10.0-x86_64.AppImage` — make it executable (right-click → Properties → *Allow executing file as program*, or `chmod +x`) and double-click it.

### What's new
- **Scan documents** — turn photos of paper into clean, straight pages. Morphix finds the corners of the sheet, fixes the angle so the page gets its real shape (A4, Letter…), removes shadows and makes the paper white. Drag any corner to adjust it, with a magnifier to place it exactly. Choose Enhanced, Original colours, Grayscale or Black & white, then save one PDF with searchable Arabic and English text — or pictures. There's also an **ID card** mode: front and back on one page at the real card size, ready to print.
- **From my phone** — scan a QR code with your phone's camera, then send photos, videos and documents (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, ZIP — any file) to your computer over the same Wi-Fi. No internet, no app, no cables. Files arrive in full quality, exactly as the phone sends them, keep their original date, and big videos keep going after a Wi-Fi hiccup. Photos can go straight into the scanner, and other files open in the Action Hub so you can pick a tool.
- **QR codes** — turn a Google Drive or OneDrive link, a website, a Wi-Fi network or a contact card into a QR code. Rounded, dots or classic style, your own colours, a logo in the middle and a line of text under it. Morphix checks that every code scans before you save it as PNG, SVG or PDF.
- **Read QR codes and barcodes** from any picture.

### Good to know
- **iPhone:** to send originals (HEIC photos, full-size videos), tap **Options** (iOS 17) or **⚙︎** (iOS 18+) in the photo picker and set **Format** to **Current** — otherwise iOS converts photos to JPG and shrinks videos before sending. The page on your phone shows this tip.
- For **From my phone**, the phone and the computer must be on the same Wi-Fi (guest networks usually block this). The first time, your computer may ask whether Morphix can accept incoming connections — choose **Allow**.
- Everything still runs on your own computer. Your files never go to any server.

> These builds are not digitally signed. Windows may show a SmartScreen warning (**More info → Run anyway**), and Smart App Control may block the app if it is turned on.
